description: bifacial_radiance is a laboratory-supported Python package for simulating bifacial photovoltaic systems, developed by contributors from research and industry. It wraps RADIANCE ray tracing with functions for constructing modules, arrays, reflective surfaces and shading objects. Weather and scene inputs support front- and rear-side irradiance analysis and photovoltaic performance calculations. Spatial coverage follows the configured installation; simulations can use individual hours or annual weather sequences. The public repository, Python package and documented tutorials provide access free under BSD-3-Clause. The tools support layout comparisons for ground-mounted arrays, carports and other solar installations. A limitation is the need to install RADIANCE and choose appropriate scene, material and weather assumptions. The current documentation also marks the old electrical-mismatch tutorial as non-functional from version 0.5.0, so older examples cannot all be assumed to work. No directly related existing catalogue record was established. The resource was assessed from documentation without running a ray-tracing calculation.
